evidence.title: README.md
evidence.locator: Overview; Key Features; Project Status; Quick Start
evidence.finding: Pre-1.0 open-source agent orchestration runs independent harness processes with roles, delegation, messaging and parallel work. CLI/Workstation web UI and own hosted Hub, container/worktree/clone modes, APIs/skills/templates and runtime brokers are documented. Apache-2.0; not an officially supported Google product.

evidence.title: docs-site/src/content/docs/choosing-a-mode.md
evidence.locator: Mode spine; Workstation; Single-node; HA hosted
evidence.finding: Every current mode requires a Hub. Local Workstation is single-user; hosted single-node SQLite or HA Postgres/object-storage may be multi-user, on user-operated VM/Cloud Run infrastructure.

evidence.title: docs-site/src/content/docs/local/agent-credentials.md
evidence.locator: Workstation vs Hosted; Host credential files; Native login methods
evidence.finding: Workstation can inject native Claude/Gemini login files and API credentials into agents. Hosted brokers require explicit Hub secrets/profile config and never read arbitrary host credential files.

evidence.title: docs-site/src/content/docs/reference/api.md
evidence.locator: Agents; Projects; Roles; Runtime brokers; Limits
evidence.finding: Hub REST APIs manage agents/projects, roles, brokers and resources. Agent CRUD/status/log/message/start/stop endpoints and per-broker running-agent admission limits are documented. Project creation supports no-Git and shared/per-agent/worktree modes.

evidence.title: docs-site/src/content/docs/reference/security.md
evidence.locator: Authentication model; Role-based scopes; Fail-closed authorization
evidence.finding: Google/GitHub OAuth, cookie sessions, agent JWT scopes, runtime broker HMAC and user revocation are documented. User/project role bindings and permission ceilings govern access.

evidence.title: docs-site/src/content/docs/hosted/single-node/auth.md
evidence.locator: Multi-user roles; External OIDC; Revocation
evidence.finding: Hosted Hub has admin/member/viewer roles, Google/GitHub OAuth and optional external OIDC federation, plus membership/suspension and session revocation controls.

evidence.title: docs-site/src/content/docs/reference/permissions-policy.md
evidence.locator: RoleBindings; AccessConstraints; Audit
evidence.finding: Positive role bindings and narrowing access boundaries apply at system/project scope. Time windows, user active-state checks and transaction-bound boundary audit history are documented; deleting boundary deletes its history.

evidence.title: docs-site/src/content/docs/hosted/user/messaging.md
evidence.locator: Native Web Chat; Shared Threads; Presence; Mobile; Default agent
evidence.finding: Feature-flagged native chat provides project shared threads, default agent, human/agent messages, presence/typing and phone browser layouts. Message delivery is not proof agent acted.

evidence.title: docs-site/src/content/docs/hosted/user/scheduling.md
evidence.locator: Recurring Schedules; Create; Timing; Pause
evidence.finding: Hub-managed cron schedules can dispatch agents/messages with timezone rules and retained creator authority. Pause/resume and creator-deleted status reasons are explicit.

evidence.title: docs-site/src/content/docs/reference/artifacts.md
evidence.locator: Experiment; Versions; Ownership/access; Reviews
evidence.finding: Artifact publishing/retrieval/review is experimental hub.artifacts default off. Hub stores versioned file/folder bytes and grants independent of publisher filesystem. CLI/web views and immutable version references are documented.

evidence.locator: web/package.json; README.md Quick Start; repository inventory for Electron, Tauri, Xcode and Android entry points
evidence.finding: The shipped UI is the Vite browser dashboard embedded in the Go CLI/server. The scoped repository has no desktop GUI package or native iOS/Android application entry point. The CLI and browser are separate from native desktop and phone clients.

evidence.title: Scion native CLI distributions
evidence.locator: Installation guide Windows and Older Linux distributions; .github/workflows/release.yml build matrix
evidence.finding: Scion publishes native macOS, Linux and Windows CLI builds. Windows is a Hub client only; server, runtime broker and local container lifecycle commands are unsupported there. The macOS/Linux CLI includes the local server and embedded web frontend.

evidence.title: Scion Substrate sandbox selection
evidence.locator: pkg/runtime/substrate_template.go lines 224-234; pkg/config/settings_v1.go lines 2920-2950; pkg/runtime/factory.go substrate case
evidence.finding: Operator-configured Substrate runtimes accept sandbox_class: microvm and map it to SANDBOX_CLASS_MICROVM when constructing an actor template. The runtime factory instantiates this backend from an explicit operator profile; it requires a compatible user-operated Substrate service.

evidence.title: Scion telemetry controls
evidence.locator: Configuration hierarchy and environment variable table, lines 17-105
evidence.finding: SCION_TELEMETRY_ENABLED controls collection entirely; telemetry.enabled and --disable-telemetry provide equivalent scoped controls. For Hub-dispatched agents project policy takes precedence over the requester and environment variables.

evidence.title: Scion provider API-key setup
evidence.locator: Provider API Key section, lines 174-198
evidence.finding: The guide explicitly lists user-supplied ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, GOOGLE_API_KEY, CODEX_API_KEY and OPENAI_API_KEY, with local environment and Hub secret setup examples.

evidence.title: Scion task input and persistence inventory
evidence.locator: cmd/task_file.go lines 26-41; pkg/ent/schema; pkg/hub and web/src routes searched for issue, task, backlog, durable state
evidence.finding: --task-file reads a prompt into the agent task.md file. The scoped persistence schema and product routes contain agent/session/project records but no separate issue/backlog entity or issue CRUD/state workflow. README instead points to external GitHub Issues, Linear, Farmtable and Beads.

evidence.title: Scion GitHub permissions and workflow inventory
evidence.locator: pkg/hub and cmd plus web/src inspected for pull_request, pull request, gh pr and GitHub routes; project-settings.ts GitHub App permissions
evidence.finding: GitHub App settings display pull-request permission status, while the scoped product code has no pull-request creation or management route/control. Agents may use their own tools, but that is not a native Scion PR workflow.
